notes.title: 🌸 Hot and Lovely : Purple Lust Name Guessing Challenge is here! 9/8~9/15 (CST)
notes.content:

[quote=author] Good evening, everyone! It’s Meow Meow here! (≧ω≦)ﾉ
This time, we’re bringing you a super fun event—💖【Name Guessing Challenge】! ✨ A mysterious lady awaits you to call out her true name…
Your mission is to correctly guess the name of the charming pink-haired beauty from the upcoming new series—Hot and Lovely: Purple! Meow Meow will provide three options~ Based on the character description below, guess this female character’s real name!
[/quote]
[h3]♟️ Character Introduction: [/h3]
She looks cool and stylish, rocking a leather outfit with an aura that commands attention~ 😎 But in reality, she’s a super gentle and incredibly kind big sister! 🌸 She’s dashing and reliable on the outside, yet her heart is as soft as cotton candy~ This contrast of cool exterior and warm interior—isn’t it just irresistible? (´∀｀)♡
Now, it’s time to test your insight and intuition!
[h3]Choose one name from the three options below; [b]only one is her true name~[/b] Come on, take a guess!
[olist]
[*]🌸 Shiori
[*]🌸 Aya
[*]🌸 Meilin
[/olist][/h3]
[code]✨ Add to your wishlist~ Bring her home and unlock more heart-pounding stories! 💘[/code]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783090/Hot_and_Lovely__Purple_Lust/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783040/Hot_and_Lovely__Purple/
[h3]🎯 How to Participate (Super Easy): [/h3]
[list]
[*]Leave your chosen number in the comment section (e.g., 1! Shiori is the one!) [h3] ❗️Also, add Hot and Lovely : Purple Lust to your wishlist❗️ to enter the giveaway~![/h3]
[*]You can comment every day to increase your chances of winning 📈 Meow Meow will reveal the answer after the event ends!
[*]We’ll randomly select 3️⃣ lucky players who guessed correctly, 💝 gifting them any game from 【Lovely Games】 x1! It could be you~ ✧(≖ ◡ ≖✿)
[*]⏳ Event Duration: Until September 15, 23:59 (CST) | Winners announced the next day
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656213/5510927fbab719fdfbed69f4db3b9d767b095ff6.png[/img]
